purpose: The single section wrapper (Section in ui.jsx): relative, vertical padding, optional pattern strip, Container, vertical stack rhythm (overridable through the stack prop).

pattern.description: Optional pattern image URL for the top strip

stack.description: Tailwind classes for the vertical rhythm between the blocks inside the section; defaults to the exported STACK constant

variants.name: without-pattern
variants.description: py-16 md:py-24 lg:py-32; content stack space-y-10 md:16 lg:20 xl:24 (or the stack prop); no top offset

variants.name: with-pattern
variants.description: Same padding and stack; the pattern strip is rendered absolutely at the top and the content stack gains pt-6 md:pt-0, only when a pattern is set
